item.title: Reading blogs is no longer fun
item.description:
I used to loved reading random blogs. I explored different blogs and subscribed to many bloggers to learn interesting things that I might never know about by myself.

But sice LLM becomes more capable of writing, the sites I often visit now flooded with AI generated content, or discuss AI related topics (including this post).

The problem is LLM helps people write down their sloppy ideas easily with very little effort. To me, wrting is such a hard task to do, and extreamly hard to do well. Writing a long essay doesn’t make it interesting. Writing about simple stuffs doesn’t mean it is useless. But writing just became so cheap nowaday. More and more average quality blogs are generated. They looks fancy in grammar and wordings, but shallow in meaning.
